geo_basis: country as the source states it
title: Georgian Football Federation websites reportedly hit by cyberattack, Azernews reports
date_note: Azernews, published 27 November, gives no earlier day for the attack.
summary: Azernews reports that three websites reportedly belonging to the Georgian Football Federation were hit by a cyberattack and showed the message "Free Palestine". The method is unknown and it is not established whether any data was compromised. Azernews says no link between the attack and the 26 November Beşiktaş match incidents in Batumi has been confirmed.
plain: Azernews reports three Georgian Football Federation websites were reportedly attacked and showed a "Free Palestine" message. How it happened, and whether data was taken, is not known.
exec: Azernews reports the federation's websites were reportedly defaced; the method and any data impact are unknown.
